system.description:
Will Amp

When you enter your Crash state, by spending 1 Pyroclasm, you begin to Overheat for the duration of the Crash state.

While overheating, Ninjutsu you cast with the Fire Release keyword gain a +2 bonus to the damage it deals. This increases to +4 at 10th level and +6 at 18th level.

While overheating, you take 1d6 fire damage at the end of each of your turns. This damage cannot be reduced or resisted by any means.
system.summary: Crash, plus +2 (+4 at 10th, +6 at 18th) damage on Fire Release Ninjutsu; take 1d6 fire at the end of each of your turns.

rules.text: +2 Fire Release Ninjutsu damage (+4 at 10th, +6 at 18th) and 1d6 fire damage to you at the end of each of your turns, unreduced (both on this effect).
rules.label: Chakra Surge: Crash (Overheat)

rules.text: Once per casting, Ninjutsu you cast deal +1d10 damage (2d10 at 7th, 3d10 at 11th, 4d10 at 15th, 5d10 at 19th; half the dice for an area). This is added automatically when you cast.
You can use two or more Moldings on one casting; you can use the Draw Reserves skill action as an Action.
